review:
Divine Drop is a 5-reel, 4-row Hacksaw Gaming slot with 14 paylines and a Greek gods theme. Its main feature is the Wild Multiplier, worth 2x up to 200x, and several wilds in one win add their values together. Wilds can land with up to three Vitality hearts; while any remain, the wild stays sticky and awards respins, losing one heart per respin.

Heart symbols restore Vitality, and the X symbol doubles every wild multiplier on the grid. Three or four FS symbols trigger the bonus games, and lone FS symbols can be collected in a meter during respins. Hacksaw lists 3/5 volatility and a 10,000x max win. It suits players who like sticky-wild respin chains.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw Gaming doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
